rationale: AC-4.3 requires record files and graph.meta.json to be byte-identical regardless of write order. N-000457 requires query output to carry graph_hash, which is the hash of all record files. The consistency AC-4.3 demands (byte-identical records) is what N-000457 relies on to make the hash meaningful.
quotes: every record file and `graph.meta.json` are byte-identical
Every query output carries `graph_hash`, the hash of all record files
